description: Three scripted Mac clients (client.attach) show one board. A call goes to the client whose user focused the board last, else the one focused most recently, else the one attached last. A client that misses its deadline or hangs up mid-call fails the call `unavailable`, naming it, and nothing is retried on another client; the next call goes to the client the choice order picks then. easld only: the app doesn't speak the client protocol yet.
